$comment: Machine requirements for office-mcp. Single owner of the toolchain facts: src/requirements.ts loads this table for the doctor report and for the missing-tools notes the tools return, and ../install.sh reads the same file with jq for `list`. Nothing here installs anything. `tool` is the binary the server runs and the name looked up on PATH; `manager install package` is the exact command for one tool; `what` names the operations the tool unlocks (the operation mapping itself lives in src/toolchain.ts, shared with the PDF runtime); `required` marks the tools the core operations (create_pdf, grayscale, optimize, bw) cannot run without — the rest only limit which operations are available.

binaries.what: ImageMagick — create_pdf image decoding and PDF writing, and the bw raster path
ghostscript — grayscale and optimize, and PDF rasterization for bw
poppler pdfinfo — info and auto page-count inspection
poppler pdffonts — info and auto embedded-font inspection
